name: electron42-bin
note: Reference only for the layout; the packaged payloads are the upstream Electron release archives, and the launcher is byte-identical to extra/electron42's electron-launcher.sh. Added for devario-utilities/mullvad-vpn, which depends on electron42.
local_adaptations: Split the runtime and chromedriver into two outputs; drop the chromedriver.debug blob and the generated buildflags header.
Reuse Arch's electron-launcher.sh (flags.conf handling, ELECTRON_IS_DEV, ELECTRON_FORCE_IS_PACKAGED) instead of the AUR launcher, so the file set matches the extra/electron42 source recipe.

Dependency set re-derived from the shipped ELF files: readelf NEEDED plus the dlopened libpulse and libpci; the libraries Arch links dynamically (brotli, c-ares, libevent, libffi, minizip, opus, zlib, freetype, harfbuzz, libxml2) are static in the upstream payload.
provides=('electron42=42.11.18') and conflicts=('electron42') keep the two providers of /usr/lib/electron42 apart, so applications depend on electron42 either way.
x86_64 only, matching devario-utilities/mullvad-vpn; the linux-arm64 archives exist upstream if aarch64 is enabled later.
